title: Convert a folder of STEP files to SolidWorks parts and assemblies

params.name: sourceFolder
params.description: Folder holding the .step / .stp files. Subfolders are included when 'recurse' is on.

params.name: outputFolder
params.description: Where the converted files go. The source folder layout is mirrored underneath it.

params.name: recurse
params.description: Also convert STEP files in subfolders of the source folder.
